summary: Constant-fold Function.name only when the function's inferred/explicit name and property integrity are statically known.

target.notes: Function names can be explicit or inferred from syntactic context. Bound functions prefix the target name with 'bound '.

semantics.property: own configurable non-writable name data property for ordinary functions

caveats: The name property is configurable and may be redefined.
Anonymous function name inference is context-sensitive; do not guess from a C# symbol name.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification SetFunctionName / Function Instances name
